Panama–Canada: Free Trade Agreement, in force 2013

Panama–Mexico: Free Trade Agreement, in force 2015

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law No. 23 of 27 April 2015 (AML/CFT legal framework, creating the Unidad de Análisis Financiero – UAF), as amended by Law No. 70 of 30 October 2019 (implementation of FATF recommendations, creation of the Non-Financial Subjects Superintendence), and Executive Decree No. 363 of 26 June 2017 (mandatory ultimate beneficial owner return administrated by the Dirección General de Ingresos – DGI), together with applicable provisions of the Panama Commercial Code and the Custody and Registration Legal Framework of the Public Registry of Panama.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation and Commercial Registry Extract of the ultimate Chinese parent company (or, for natural-person subscribers, a notarized certified copy of the passport)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: State Administration for Market Regulation of the People's Republic of China (or provincial market supervision authority); notary public in the last domicile of the physical person
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (People's Republic of China Ministry of Foreign Affairs or delegated provincial foreign affairs office)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney appointing the Panamanian registered agent and resident agent for service of process, executed by all shareholders or the corporate parent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in China (for foreign execution) or a Panama Notary (if executed locally)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (China or Panama; apostille path applicable for 2025 submissions)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: UBO attestation and AML/CFT identification forms fully completed and signed by each ultimate beneficial owner, in accordance with the UBO return requirements of Executive Decree No. 363/2017
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Panama-registered agent, resident legal counsel, or compliance officer
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized before a Panama Notary; apostille not required for internal registry, but notarization mandatory

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified Spanish translation of the Chinese corporate creation charter and current commercial register certificate, or of the beneficial owner's identity documents if in a non-Spanish language
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Public translator registered in Panama or, alternatively, translation by the Chinese MFA-accredited translator with certified signature legalized under the Special Legalization Regime
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille on the original document and notarization of the translator's signature

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all shareholders, directors, officers, attorneys-in-fact, and 25%+ indirect beneficial owners against the OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council Consolidated List, EU Consolidated Sanctions List, and the Panamanian UAF-issued national sanctions/ENF reference list. Enhanced due diligence is mandatory for any Politically Exposed Person (PEP), including family members and close associates, with threshold escalation at 10% where the government entity is a contracting counterpart. Name hits trigger immediate suspension of incorporation and mandatory suspicious transaction report to the UAF within 48 hours. Data retention in accordance with Law 23/2015 and its amending regulations.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Público de Panamá – Online Name Reservation Service (Oficina de Reserva de Nombres en Línea, portal www.registro-publico.gob.pa)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The corporate name must be expressed in Spanish or, when foreign, forcibly transliterated into Latin alphabetic characters. Chinese characters and non-Latin alphabets are not accepted in the Public Registry system. The S.A. denomination must include an appropriate corporate type identifier (e.g., 'Sociedad Anónima' or 'S.A.'). The transliteration must be an irreversible, phonologically correct transcription of the Chinese name; the registry reserves the right to require a Spanish descriptive term where the name is not easily readable in commerce.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant or its registered agent may file a written motion for reconsideration ('recurso de reconsideración') addressed to the Director General of the Public Registry within five (5) business days of receiving the refusal notice. The motion must indicate the proposed alternative name or correct the grounds of refusal. If reconsideration is denied, an administrative appeal ('recurso de apelación') may be filed within five (5) business days before the hierarchical higher body of the Public Registry, if available; otherwise the applicant may proceed directly to a contentious-administrative action before the Sala Tercera de la Corte Suprema de Justicia within two (2) months from final administrative denial. Official fee for appeal filing is US$12.00 approximately, payable at the registry treasury.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual office acceptable solely as the statutory seat and legal address provided through the registered agent's physical office in Panama; however, this does not constitute a valid operating location for the specialty fresh bakery and central kitchen operations. The company must obtain a distinct physical commercial premises in Panama City or other eligible operation zone for cooking, storage, and retail sales, and must acquire a municipal operating permit ('Aviso de Operación') and Ministry of Health (MINSA) sanitary permit before opening. The corporate virtual address cannot be the bakery's operational address.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 35% likelihood of an unannounced sanitary and municipal inspection within the first twelve months of operation due to the food-sector classification under ISIC 5610 and the presence of a central kitchen; routine biennial inspections thereafter, with accelerated probability for health complaints.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name availability search and reservation certificate (1 preferred name and 2 alternates)
Notarization of the incorporation deed (Escritura Pública de Constitución) before a Panama Notary
Registration of the corporation (Inscripción de la Sociedad) in the Public Registry of Panama
Registered agent service fee for year one, including provision of legal seat address
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Panama Registered Agent (licensed professional or fiduciary)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/CFT customer due diligence, UBO identification, PEP and OFAC/SDN screening, and compliance file preparation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registered agent or external compliance officer

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille, legalization, and certified Spanish translation of Chinese corporate/identity documents (3 documents)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Chinese MFA (apostille) and certified Panamanian translator
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Cost recovery and prevailing translation tariff

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Issuance of certified copies of the registered articles, certificate of incorporation, and UBO registry receipt

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Panama General Corporation Law (Ley 32 de 1927), as amended; applicable articles on incorporation, capital stock, and governing bodies: Articles 1, 9–14, 20–24, 30–33, 51–60, and 71–75.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Sección de Mercantil (Panama Public Registry, Mercantile Section)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Public Deed of Incorporation (Escritura Pública de Constitución de Sociedad Anónima), registered with the Mercantile Section of the Public Registry.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital is required. Founder can declare a nominal capital (commonly US$10,000), and funds need not be escrowed. At least one issued and subscribed share is necessary to form a valid S.A.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: That the subscription of the Company's stated capital be and hereby is accepted as set forth in Schedule A, and that share certificates be issued accordingly. RESOLVED: That the registered office located at [Panama address] and the resident agency of [Agent firm] be and hereby are adopted and approved. RESOLVED: That [Name] be appointed President, [Name] Secretary, and [Name] Treasurer, each to serve until successors are elected. RESOLVED: That the appointed officers be and hereby are authorized, jointly or severally, to open bank accounts, execute agreements, and complete filings before the Public Registry and revenue authorities.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Name Department (Oficina de Nombres), Registro Público de Panamá
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit up to three proposed corporate names in Spanish via the Public Registry's name request procedure. Wait for issuance of a negative certificate or reservation certificate confirming the name is not registered to another entity.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the preferred name is rejected due to similarity, file alternates in the order originally stated. If rejection is for incomplete documentation, correct deficiencies and resubmit within 15 working days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of the Public Deed of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public (Notaría) in the Republic of Panama
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the articles of incorporation in Spanish, defining the corporate object as specialty fresh bakery, pastry manufacturing, central kitchen operations, and franchise activity. Founder-subscribers appear before the Panamanian notary, execute the public deed, and pay notarial fees.
required_dossiers: Passports or identity documents of subscribing shareholders
AML corporate questionnaire for each founder
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary identifies legal defects, the deed will be revised and restated before execution. Should a lawful clause conflict with the Public Registry fee schedule, the articles are amended and a corrective deed is executed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration with the Panama Public Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Mercantile Section, Registro Público de Panamá
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the notarized public deed and its certified copy for inscription in the Mercantile Section. Upon payment of the registration fee, the Registry assigns the Company's inscription number and issuance of the Certificate of Registration, thereby conferring legal personality.
required_dossiers: Cover sheet and copy for registry filing
Proof of payment of registration fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry issues a provisional rejection specifying defects, a lawyer should file an 'escrito de subsanación' within five working days with corrected information. Where capital errors exist, execute a corrective deed before the notary and re-submit.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Appointment of Resident Agent and Registered Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Resident Agent Firm in Panama
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute a resident agency agreement with a Panamanian law firm or licensed agent. The registered office is kept at the agent's physical address. The Public Registry must be updated with the agent's acceptance and address.
required_dossiers: Board resolution adopting the registered office
Proof of right to use the registered address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a resident agent resigns, the Company must appoint a successor within the statutory period. Failure to maintain a resident agent can lead to administrative suspension and should be cured by immediate re-appointment.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Resolution and Corporate Governance Setup
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors through the Corporate Secretary
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board session or adopt a written board resolution. Ratify share subscription, approve the registered office, appoint officers, and issue share certificates. Open the corporate records: board minutes book, share ledger, and officer registry.
required_dossiers: Written consent or minutes of the board meeting
Subscription list and capital contribution records
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If an appointed officer lacks capacity, the board may remove and replace the officer by unanimous written consent and file corrective minutes with the corporate records.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Municipality of the registered location (e.g., Municipio de Panamá) in conjunction with the Ministry of Health (MINSA) – Regional Health Authority
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Aviso de Operación (Municipal Operation Notice) and Sanitary Permit (Permiso Sanitario)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category I – Environmental Registration (Baja Complejidad) for bakery and central kitchen operations; a full Environmental Impact Study is not required for this retail production profile.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with CTE and COPANIT wastewater discharge limits; treated effluent must suspend grease-trap maintenance and solids, with BOD/COD and suspended solids within permitted standards; kitchen exhaust systems must meet MINSA VOC and particulate concentration limits; solid waste segregation and disposal must follow municipal ordinances.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate issued by the Benemérito Cuerpo de Bomberos de Panamá; structural load inspection and certification for commercial kitchen installation; municipal occupancy inspection; occupational health and workplace hygiene clearance from the Ministry of Labor (MITRADEL).

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Autoridad Nacional de Impuestos (ANI) — successor to the Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) of the Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas; electronic administration via the ANI 'Sede Electrónica' (e-Tax) portal at etax.ani.gob.pa, with taxpayer onboarding through the Registro Único de Contribuyentes (RUC).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a foreign-owned Panamanian Sociedad Anónima: (1) file the incorporation Escritura Pública with the Registro Público de Panamá and appoint a licensed resident agent; (2) obtain the Aviso de Operación (business-operation certificate) via the national Aviso de Operación system and the relevant municipal licence; (3) register in the RUC through the ANI e-Tax portal or authorised banking/notarial kiosk by presenting the Escritura, Aviso de Operación, and identification of the ultimate beneficial owners and resident agent; (4) receive the RUC number (statutory TIN), which simultaneously activates the ISR and ITBMS accounts; (5) complete the electronic-invoicing onboarding profile in e-Tax and, if exporting, enrol with the customs single window (VUPE/SICE). A non-resident entity deriving Panamanian-source income may register directly or through its agent; a company with only foreign-source operations may remain outside the RUC but must register if it employs local workers, owns Panamanian real property, or executes taxable local supplies.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Territorial_Scope — the S.A. is a separate entity-level taxpayer for Impuesto Sobre la Renta (ISR) on Panamanian-source income only; foreign-source profits, dividends, and out-of-territory service income are excluded from the taxable base; no pass-through or tax-consolidation election exists for an S.A.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No 'check-the-box' or hybrid-mismatch election is available under Panamanian law; territorial-source rules are mandatory. Available elections: (a) adoption of 'Sociedad de Capital Variable' flexible capital rules at incorporation; (b) simplified presumptive 'pequeno contribuyente' regime for activities with annual gross receipts up to B/.36,000; (c) optional Multinational Headquarters (SEM) regime, if separately authorised, which grants special ISR and ITBMS treatment; (d) prior-approval alternative duties computation in customs valuations for related-party imports.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: ITBMS (Impuesto de Transferencia de Bienes Muebles y Servicios) — the Panamanian value-added tax on the supply of movable goods and the rendering of services within the customs territory.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Mandatory ITBMS registration from the first taxable operation — no de minimis turnover exemption; as an administrative grace, independent and small businesses with annual gross income up to B/.36,000 may elect the simplified presumptive payment regime (Resolution ANI-DGA-002-2024) while remaining registered, paying a reduced quarterly ITBMS without full input-credit mechanics.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Factura Electrónica en Línea is mandatory under the ANI e-Tax system: every invoice, credit note, and debit note must be generated by ANI-certified software or approved fiscal hardware (smart POS/fiscal signer), digitally stamped with a unique ANI authorisation code (QR-style digital stamp), and cleared in near real-time by transmission to the ANI central validation platform with the prescribed API/XML schema at the moment of issue. A non-authorised or offline invoice is not legal tax documentation, the input tax credit embedded therein is disallowed, and exporters relying on such invoices lose the corresponding export refund. Special 'control sheets' and foreign-trade invoices may require additional fiscal marks in accordance with ANI technical annexes.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods (including packaged fresh and frozen Chinese pastry products) may be invoiced at 0% ITBMS upon proof that the goods were physically removed from Panamanian customs territory by the vendor within the statutory term and title/risk passed to the foreign buyer. Services of a pure offshore character — including master-franchise royalties and technical-assistance fees billed to foreign master franchisees for activities performed entirely outside Panama — fall outside the territorial ITBMS base and are not subject to tax. Eligibility requirements: registered exporter status with the RUC, customs exit properly declared through VUPE/SICE, the seller must hold valid supporting documentation, and the seller must be in full compliance with all ISR and ITBMS filings and monthly payments. Excess input ITBMS recorded on local purchases allocated to zero-rated exports can be offset against any positive output ITBMS, with the residual balance recoverable through the formal ANI exporter refund procedure (Solicitud de Devolucion del Credito Fiscal); refund requests are subject to documentary desk review and discretionary on-site inspection by ANI.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Declaracion de Exportacion, DEX) submitted via SICE/VUPE (Ventanilla Unica de Comercio Exterior)
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill evidencing physical departure of the goods from Panamanian customs territory
Commercial Invoice, Packing List, and, where applicable, sanitary/phytosanitary export certificate for food products
Inward Remittance Certificate (bank SWIFT/MT103 advice or credit slip) evidencing receipt of hard-currency export proceeds
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: ANI and the customs authority jointly audit export zero-rating and refund claims. A disallowed claim is immediately clawed back together with the underlying input-credit refund, statutory late-interest accruing monthly, and recargos (surcharges) of 10% to 25% on the omitted tax. Issuance of false e-invoices attracts fines between B/.1,000 and B/.50,000 per document. Aggravated tax fraud (Defraudacion Tributaria, Penal Code Article 280-B) is punishable by two to five years of imprisonment plus temporary closure of the establishment, and fraudulent customs export declarations additionally expose the taxpayer to smuggling-based penalties, cancellation of the exporter registry authorisation, and exclusion from the export zero-rating regime for the corresponding tax periods.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá (SBP) as the primary banking and financial regulatory authority, with the Banco Central de Panamá established under Law 23 of 2023 as the transitional monetary authority; Banco Nacional de Panamá serves as the fiscal agent of the Republic. The Unidad de Análisis Financiero (UAF) supervises AML/CFT compliance.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Panama operates a fully dollarized monetary system under Law 84 of 1904 and Decree Law 3 of 1904. The U.S. dollar is unlimited legal tender; the Panamanian balboa (PAB) exists only as a 1:1 unit of account with no fiduciary banknote issuance. There are no exchange controls, no capital account restrictions, and no central-bank approval gates for current or capital account transactions. Profit remittance is fully convertible in USD and subject only to operational tax clearance (Paz y Salvo del Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas) and, where applicable, the 5% dividend withholding tax and ITBMS compliance; no FX conversion hurdle exists.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. Because Panama maintains no sovereign currency requiring conversion, there is no statutory timeline or mandatory conversion ratio for export receipts. Export proceeds may be retained in USD in any local or offshore account without surrender to the central bank. Banking institutions must nevertheless file cash transaction reports exceeding USD 10,000 and suspicious activity reports to the UAF under Law 23 of 2015.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account with Capital Escrow Sub-account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low. Panama has no standalone electronic-money institution (EMI) licensing regime equivalent to EU or UK passporting. Non-bank fintech providers must obtain SBP authorization to intermediate funds under Decree Law 2 of 2008, and any holding of Panamanian client balances triggers deposit-taking and AML/CFT supervision under Law 23 of 2015. Offshore digital EMIs such as Wise, Airwallex, or Currencycloud may operate strictly as disbursement-only rails for low-value utility or supplier payments, but they cannot serve as the primary treasury clearing layer. The bakery franchise treasury should maintain all operating liquidity in SBP-licensed local banks and use EMIs only for ancillary cross-border disbursements.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: At least one duly appointed director or legal representative is required by dominant bank policy to appear physically at the Panama City branch for a face-to-face KYC interview. Remote opening is feasible only at banks with documented digital onboarding programs (e.g., Banco General SME digital pilot) where apostilled incorporation documents, notarized board resolutions, and a live video interview are accepted. Given the Low_Risk_Standard AML classification of an ISIC 5610 bakery franchise operation, structured remote onboarding is moderately viable, but physical presence of the CFO or authorized signatory remains the compliance-protective default.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO opacity and historical bearer-share profile of the Panamanian S.A.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized chain-of-title from the share register post-Law 47 of 2013, UBO declaration form per Law 23 of 2015, legalized certificate of incorporation and constituent documents, corporate organizational chart evidencing Chinese parent ownership and ultimate directorship.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source-of-wealth insufficiency for the franchise capital injection and master-franchise entry fee.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Six to twelve months of bank statements for each funding shareholder, audited financial statements of the PRC parent company, executed master franchise agreement, central kitchen lease agreement, CAPEX equipment quotations, and Paz y Salvo tax clearance certificate.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cash-intensity of retail bakery POS revenue versus declared income profile.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Daily POS Generation Z reports, merchant settlement statements from the acquirer, ITBMS (7% VAT) monthly filing receipts from the DGI, monthly payroll reconciliation with Caja de Seguro Social contributions.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border related-party payments to Chinese equipment and ingredient suppliers.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Commercial invoices, bills of lading, SIGA customs declaration forms, master franchise and license agreements, and arm's-length transfer pricing documentation where annual related-party flows exceed USD 250,000.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore jurisdiction red-flag triggered by Panama S.A. ownership structure and historical FATF grey-listing status.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: FATF removal confirmation dated October 27, 2023, UAF compliance attestation, AML/CFT compliance manual implementing Law 23 of 2015, and engagement of an SBP-registered Panamanian resident agent with idoneidad certificate.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: SWIFT MT103 wire from the Chinese parent bank to the Panama S.A. USD operational account at Banco General, referencing 'Aporte de Capital / Equity Contribution under Corporate Resolution No. 001-2025'. The receiving bank requires a certified board resolution authorizing the capital contribution, a notarized share-capital increase entry where applicable, a sworn statement of lawful funds (Declaración Jurada), and UAF CDD forms. No prior central-bank FX authorization is required given full dollarization. Inbound wires exceeding USD 100,000 trigger enhanced due diligence and OFAC-compliant sanctions screening; the funds should be routed into a dedicated capital escrow sub-account to establish a clear UBO contribution trail.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: USD-denominated SWIFT MT103 transfers for master royalties and international ingredient suppliers; bulk flour, sugar, edible oil, and packaging imports are settled via irrevocable Commercial Letters of Credit (UCP 600) or documentary sight collections through issuing banks such as Banistmo or BAC International Bank. Domestic bakery POS collections and payroll ACH clear through the SBP national clearing house and local debit-card networks. High-value interbank settlements route via Fedwire and CHIPS through U.S. correspondent banks, with typical 2–3 business-day finality.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: No PAB/USD forward or NDF market exists because the balboa is contractually pegged 1:1 to the U.S. dollar; domestic FX hedging is structurally unnecessary.
USD interest-rate swaps and cross-currency swaps denominated in USD executed at international treasury desks (e.g., Banistmo and BAC treasury divisions).
CNH/USD non-deliverable forwards for procurement of Chinese pastry equipment and ingredients sourced from PRC suppliers.
Commodity forward and futures overlays for wheat-flour and edible-oil price risk (CBOT ZW wheat and soybean-oil contracts) executed through a licensed futures commission merchant.
Zero-cost collar and plain-vanilla USD interest-rate option structures for fixed-rate supply or leasing contracts exceeding USD 500,000.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Franchise Tax Payment (Tasa Única de la República)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Directorate of Revenues (Dirección General de Ingresos - DGI) of Panama
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before January 15 of each calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment after January 15 triggers a USD 100 penalty plus monthly interest; failure to pay for three consecutive years subjects the corporation to administrative strike-off from the Public Registry of Panama.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Return (Declaración de Renta de Personas Jurídicas)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Directorate of Revenues (DGI) of Panama
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: March 15 following the fiscal year-end (December 31); automatic extension to May 31 when financial statements are prepared and attested by a licensed Panamanian CPA
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines ranging from USD 50 to USD 500, a 10% surcharge on unpaid tax, and monthly compounding interest up to 1%; persistent delinquency can lead to tax attachment and suspension of the corporate RUC registration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Municipal Operating License Renewal (Aviso de Operación)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Municipal government of each operating district (e.g., Alcaldía de Panamá)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: January 31 of each calendar year for the capital; renewal by the anniversary of initial registration for other municipalities
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Imposition of municipal fines, interest on arrears, potential closure of the bakery premises, and revocation of the Aviso de Operación if renewal is not completed within the municipal grace period.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit applies to Panama corporations with annual gross income above USD 1.5 million or total assets above USD 3 million, as required by the DGI for filing audited financial statements; for a bakery master franchise with central kitchen operations, franchise agreements may independently require certified audits regardless of size.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) as adopted by Panama’s College of Certified Public Accountants; small and medium-sized entities may apply the IFRS for SMEs framework.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under Panama Law 70 of 2019 and Executive Decree 299 of 2020, the corporation must file the register of ultimate beneficial owners with the DGI Beneficial Ownership Registry and must update that register within 30 days after any share transfer or beneficial ownership change. No separate annual reconfirmation is statutorily prescribed, but the resident agent must at each corporate act, including the payment of the annual franchise tax, verify that the UBO filing is current and accurate.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Shareholders (Libro de Registro de Acciones)
Register of Directors (Libro de Registro de Directores)
Minute Book of Shareholders’ Assembly (Libro de Actas de Asamblea de Accionistas)
Minute Book of Board of Directors’ Meetings (Libro de Actas de Juntas Directivas)
Accounting Ledgers and Financial Records required for tax purposes

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Panama taxes on a territorial basis: only Panama-source income is within the corporate income tax net. Graduated relief applies: 15% on the first USD 200,000 of taxable income, 20% on taxable income from USD 200,001 to USD 1,500,000, and the 25% headline rate only on taxable income exceeding USD 1,500,000. Foreign-source revenue of the Panamanian S.A. is excluded from the taxable base. Additional incentives include deductions for productive-asset investments and reinvestment under DGI-approved rulings. Franchise royalties collected by the Panamanian pastry-chain S.A. from Panama-based licensees are Panama-source income and fully taxable.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 2 (Form 2) - Declaración de Renta de Personas Jurídicas; filed via the Panama DGI E.Tax 2.0 electronic portal (etax.dgi.gob.pa).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 3 months after the fiscal year-end; for calendar-year taxpayers the statutory date is 31 March of the following year. Advance corporate income tax payments (anticipos) are required during the current year through the DGI monthly estimate mechanism.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross receipts from bakery sales, catering, POS cash and card revenue, and delivery income generated in Panama.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident-owned S.A. reports only Panama-source gross receipts. Revenue from entirely foreign operations is excluded under territoriality; retain customer contracts and POS settlement records.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Other Panama-source income: master-franchise royalties received from local sub-franchisees, equipment leasing, interest, and capital gains on Panama-situated assets.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Royalty income received by the Panamanian franchisor is Panama-source because the underlying franchise rights are exploited in Panama; attach the franchise agreements and transfer-pricing documentation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cost of goods sold and direct operating expenses: raw materials, flour, fillings, packaging, central-kitchen payroll, rent, utilities, and logistics.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Deductible only when incurred to obtain Panama-source income and supported by DGI-compliant invoices. Purchases from the Chinese parent or affiliates must be priced at arm's length.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Depreciation and amortization: ovens, production equipment, leasehold improvements, and acquired franchise intangible assets.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Intangibles acquired from foreign affiliates require an independent valuation and must satisfy the arm's-length standard; statutory useful-life tables apply.
Only Panama-source losses incurred by the same taxpayer can be carried forward, for a maximum of 5 years; a significant change in beneficial ownership may restrict the loss.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income and application of graduated rates: 15% up to USD 200,000; 20% from USD 200,001 to USD 1,500,000; 25% above USD 1,500,000.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Compute in US Dollar / Balboa amounts. Non-resident-owned corporations apply the same graduated tables as resident corporations.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Advance income tax payments, withholding tax credits, and foreign tax credits where applicable.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Credit local Panamanian withholding suffered on interest, royalties, and services; the balance is payable with the Form 2 submission.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net tax balance payable or refund; transfer-pricing annex; economic-substance declaration reference.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach the contemporaneous transfer-pricing annex and ESR confirmation when thresholds are met; DGI may require the full Local File within 30 days of request.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing triggers a fine of 10% of the tax due (minimum USD 50), a monthly surcharge of 1% per month or fraction on the unpaid tax, and monthly arrears interest at DGI-published rates. Persistent non-filing permits DGI default assessment and suspension of the commercial license (Aviso de Operación).
